recognize_zh: 周邊血液中可見三個成熟單核球：核摺疊或呈腎形、染色質細緻、細胞質豐富灰藍並有少量空泡，旁邊僅一個嗜中性球，顯示單核球比例明顯增加，符合 CMML。
features: Three mature monocytes with folded, indented or reniform nuclei and fine lacy chromatin
Abundant gray-blue cytoplasm with irregular borders and occasional small vacuoles
Monocytes outnumber neutrophils in the field (single segmented neutrophil)
No blasts or promonocytes with nucleoli seen in this field
Red cells largely normocytic and normochromic
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows an increase in mature-appearing monocytes, with folded to reniform nuclei, fine chromatin and abundant gray-blue, focally vacuolated cytoplasm. A single segmented neutrophil is also present. Blasts and promonocytes are not identified in this field, and red cells are unremarkable. With the reported leukocytosis and absolute monocytosis, findings are consistent with chronic myelomonocytic leukemia.

ddx.vs: Promonocytes and monoblasts have delicately folded nuclei with visible nucleoli and more basophilic cytoplasm, and together exceed 20%.
Reactive monocytosis lacks dysplasia and clonality, and flow shows a normal classical-monocyte (CD14+CD16-) fraction below 94%.
JMML occurs in young children with RAS-pathway mutations and elevated HbF.
